method: One direct API Lambda smoke followed by bounded CloudWatch span reads

runtime_trace.lookup: Confirmed deployed Runtime endpoint log group, spans stream, same bounded time window

diagnosis.method: Bounded read of existing Runtime telemetry logs; no additional invocations
diagnosis.proposed_fix: Send equivalent X-Ray traceId alongside traceParent, preserving parent identity and sampling
diagnosis.caveat: Unsampled Runtime context explains missing recorded spans; the precise service-side header handling is not directly observed.

limitations: Trace and span IDs were compared during inspection and replaced with aliases in this public artifact.
The smoke bypasses API Gateway using an IAM-authorized Lambda invocation with simulated authorizer context.
A successful Runtime response does not prove Runtime span retention or parent propagation; empty bounded reads do not establish the cause.
The additional local Runtime request span is not published; no image or infrastructure was changed for this check.
